notes.title: Code cleanup and minor bug fixes in preparation of DLC
notes.content:
Despite being a rather simple casual game, no game is ever developed bug-free. In order to prepare for our DLC we fixed them. See the changes below. 

The DLC will give players with certain bluetooth enabled massage devices the opportunity to not only play the game, but to "experience" it. Wishlist now under [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874310/Reveal_Your_Monster__Toy_Support/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874310/Reveal_Your_Monster__Toy_Support/[/url] and get your personal haptic feedback DLC on June 1st 2022!

Changes in this update:
- [feature] Separate credits screen to declutter UI
- [fix] Text would not load correct localization on level change
- [fix] UI elements on widescreen displays are severely overlapping
